name: MAGNETIC STIRRER WATER BATH
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Magnetic Stirrer Water Bath is an advanced workstation used heavily in chemical synthesis and biology laboratories. It allows researchers to simultaneously heat and independently stir multiple flasks. Integrating magnetic drive points beneath the stainless steel water tank, it offers an elegant solution for synchronized, contamination-free mixing during precise incubation procedures.
features: Combination of water bath and magnetic stirrer in a single unit
Available in single and multi-position models (1, 4, 8, or 12 stations)
Uniform temperature distribution via internal DC motor driven circulation
Stainless steel spring-loaded clamps to securely hold conical flasks
Precise temperature and RPM speed control with digital displays
Supplied with Teflon coated magnetic stir bars

specifications.Stirrer Speed: Up to 1200 RPM controlled by speed regulator
specifications.Inner Water Circulation: DC motor driven stirrer / magnetic pump
